description: The first CLI and local database for The Points Guy: search every article, look up any card's real terms, and turn points valuations into answers you can script.

novel_features.name: Redeem-vs-cash checker
novel_features.description: Tells you whether to use points or pay cash for a specific booking, using TPG's valuation as the baseline.

novel_features.name: Points value calculator
novel_features.description: Converts a points/miles balance into an estimated dollar value using TPG's monthly valuation.

novel_features.name: Multi-program portfolio value
novel_features.description: Values many balances across different programs at once from stdin or a file and totals them.

novel_features.name: Card side-by-side compare
novel_features.description: Compares two or more credit cards across annual fee, APRs, welcome bonus, and rewards.

novel_features.name: Valuation drift over time
novel_features.description: Shows how a program's cents-per-point value changed month over month.

novel_features.name: Recent publishing window
novel_features.description: Lists everything TPG published in the last N hours or days across all categories.
